binding_requirements: repository base commit and tree, dirty flag
retention laboratory source digest (research/ecs_retention_r0/*.py) and CANDIDATES.md SHA-256
SHA-256 of the loaded libelpis_ecsg_math shared library
compiler identity and version, build type and C flags of the build that produced it
numerical profile: numpy version, Python version, machine, BLAS/OpenMP thread settings (single-threaded)

dev_rules.candidate: at the chosen offset, for every candidate configuration (C1 and C2 at every grid lambda) on every DEV world: count DEV worlds with LEARNED_B and RETAINED_A. Select the configuration with the largest count; ties by the smallest median over DEV worlds of (nmse_A_after_B + nmse_B_after), then by smaller extra_state_bytes, then by grid order (C1 before C2, smaller lambda first). The best configuration of the other family by the same rule is the secondary candidate. M1 is never selected.
dev_rules.nothing_else: DEV chooses only the offset, the selected configuration and the secondary configuration. The step budget, rate, thresholds, grids and gates are fixed here.
dev_rules.task: for offset in offset_grid in order: run M0 (W_A) and M1 on every DEV world; choose the first offset at which every DEV world is LEARNED_A and M1 is LEARNED_B and RETAINED_A in every DEV world. If no offset qualifies, choose the offset with the most DEV worlds satisfying all three (ties: smaller offset) and record REPLAY_INFEASIBLE_ON_DEV.

mechanics_checks.binding: every evidence record binds the implementation fields in binding_requirements and QUAL refuses if any differs from the frozen values
mechanics_checks.engine_equivalence: the laboratory engine with the consolidation term removed reproduces the canonical core's W_AB bitwise from W_A, every QUAL world
mechanics_checks.feature_identity: 1/2 phi(x) . S3(W) equals the canonical forward map within 1e-10 relative on the evaluation inputs of every QUAL world at W_A
mechanics_checks.no_baseline_refusal: M0 and M1 learn without refusal in every QUAL world
mechanics_checks.pte_microstate: two microstates with identical S3 (the Cognitive R0 PTE construction on axis 0 from W0), each with its own consolidation built from A's experienced inputs (identical for C1), diverge after one identical selected-candidate step on B (S3 relative difference >= 1e-9): W remains authoritative
mechanics_checks.shared_W_A: W_A is bitwise identical across mechanisms in every QUAL world

M0.definition: plain sequential G1 through the canonical core: W_A = G1^K(W0; A), W_AB = G1^K(W_A; B)

M1.definition: W_AB = G1^K(W_A; A u B), one 128-row batch through the canonical executor

O.definition: unconstrained least-squares representability ceiling in S3 coordinates (analysis only)

metrics.RETAINED_A: nmse_A_after_B <= 0.5 and nmse_A_after_B <= 0.5 * nmse_A_init (the Cognitive R0 RETAINED class)
metrics.compute_overhead: laboratory-engine wall time of learning B divided by the same engine's time for lambda = 0, plus analytic extra floating-point operations per step
metrics.extra_state_bytes: exact float64 bytes of the mechanism's additional mutable state (CANDIDATES.md)
metrics.nmse: mean over the test_rows held-out rows of (f_W(x) - y)^2 divided by the population variance of those held-out targets

name: ecsg-retention-r0

pass_rule.A_acquisition: every QUAL world LEARNED_A; median over QUAL worlds of nmse_A_after_A <= 0.25
pass_rule.B_acquisition: selected candidate: every QUAL world LEARNED_B
pass_rule.C_retention: selected candidate: every QUAL world RETAINED_A (central gate)
pass_rule.D_joint_state: selected candidate: A and B are answered by one final W per world (one executor created from W_AB answers both; recorded state digest); no task label at query
pass_rule.E_state_causality: selected candidate, every QUAL world: (i) an executor restored from the snapshot of the executor holding W_AB reproduces its A and B responses bitwise; (ii) an executor created from W0 reproduces the untaught responses bitwise; (iii) ablation state_removed (same engine, consolidation term removed): not RETAINED_A in at least 75% of QUAL worlds, and the candidate's median nmse_A_after_B <= 0.5 x the ablation's median nmse_A_after_B
pass_rule.F_no_external_answer_store: selected candidate: its consolidation is computed from W_A and A's experienced inputs only (no targets reach it) and its queries read only W; checked structurally and recorded
pass_rule.G_determinism: selected candidate, world qual-0000: the full pipeline run twice in process and once in a clean process from the frozen specification yields identical final W digests and identical metrics
pass_rule.H_negative_baseline: M0: not RETAINED_A in at least 75% of QUAL worlds and median retention_ratio >= 10
pass_rule.I_control_honesty: M1 is reported separately as EXTERNAL_MEMORY_CONTROL and is never the selected candidate
pass_rule.J_capacity_accounting: every mechanism reports extra_state_bytes and compute_overhead
pass_rule.disposition: MECHANICS_FAIL if any mechanics check fails. Else RETENTION_SUPPORTED_UNDER_FROZEN_SYNTHETIC_REGIME (OUTCOME_A) if A-J hold for the selected candidate. Else PARTIAL_REDUCTION (OUTCOME_C) if the selected candidate's median retention_ratio <= 0.5 x M0's median retention_ratio; else REPLAY_ONLY (OUTCOME_B) if M1 is LEARNED_B and RETAINED_A in every QUAL world; else NO_MATERIAL_IMPROVEMENT (OUTCOME_D). M1's own result is always reported. A failure is recorded as it is; a repair is a new experiment version.

question: Can one ECS_G state acquire experience B while retaining experience A, and what state does that require?

regime.note: the Cognitive R0 v1 regime (d, N, initialization, rate, teachers, input scale, rows, step budget) for comparability

secondary.ablations: mismatched_statistics and uninformed_statistics for the selected candidate (CANDIDATES.md); reported, not gating
secondary.performance: PERFORMANCE_ONLY NO_SCIENTIFIC_CLAIM: canonical executor learn latency for M0/M1 and laboratory-engine latency per candidate; not part of the disposition
secondary.sequence: A -> B -> C -> D at the chosen offset for M0, M1 (rehearsal of every earlier experience), the selected and the secondary candidate (cumulative consolidation); nmse of every seen task after every stage; counts of RETAINED and LEARNED tasks at the end. Descriptive, not gating.

shared_procedure: W_A is computed once per world through the canonical core (CognitiveCore.learn, K steps on A) and is bitwise identical for every mechanism
candidate consolidation is computed at W_A from A's experienced inputs only (never targets)

candidate learning of B: every step is the canonical native G1 step (an executor created from the current W performs one learn step) followed by subtracting rate x the candidate's consolidation gradient evaluated at the pre-step W: W_{t+1} = G1(W_t) - eta * grad P(W_t), K steps at the frozen rate; a refused native step or any non-finite value refuses the whole learn and W_AB = W_A (canonical refusal semantics), recorded as refused
every response used by any metric is the canonical native forward map (elpis.ECS_G.native.Executor.forward) of the evaluated W
one final W per world and mechanism answers both A and B queries; no task label reaches a query

splits.ids: DEV: dev-0000..dev-0007; QUAL: qual-0000..qual-0023; mechanics tests use test-* ids only
splits.isolation: DEV runs refuse once frozen; QUAL refuses unless frozen and runs once; QUAL worlds are never evaluated before the freeze
splits.rng: every random draw is a function of (seed, experiment name, world id, stream); worlds are disjoint by id; no global RNG

tasks.definition: task t: an independent cubic ridge teacher (teacher_width columns, entries N(0, teacher_scale^2)); inputs N(sign * offset * e_axis, input_scale^2 I); train_rows experience rows and test_rows held-out rows, all per world from the frozen RNG streams
